mapper.select: select t1.component, t1.component_name, t1.status, t1.detail, t1.since_time, t1.last_check_time from sys_component_status t1 order by t1.component
mapper.insert: insert into sys_component_status (component, component_name, status, detail, since_time, last_check_time) values (#{component}, #{componentName}, #{status}, #{detail}, #{now}, #{now}) on duplicate key update component_name = #{componentName}, detail = #{detail}, since_time = if(status = #{status}, since_time, #{now}), status = #{status}, last_check_time = #{now}
